name: The 511 Labelled Square Completions of the 577-Concept Double
definition: Take two translated copies of the certified $289$-concept rooted factor in disjoint twelve-coordinate blocks. Their cornerless one-point double $X$ has $577$ concepts. For any nonempty subset $\Gamma$ of the nine pairs between root directions $\{1,2,8\}$ and $\{13,14,20\}$, add the corresponding cross-block square tips.
parameters: There are $2^9-1=511$ labelled choices. A set of $k$ pairs produces $577+k$ concepts, dimension $24$, VC dimension $3$, and exactly $k$ degree-two corners. No count of graph-isomorphism classes is asserted.
properties: Every output is a two-connected ample forbidden pc-minor, and deleting all added corners returns the cut-vertex obstruction $X$. The single-pair choice $\{(1,13)\}$ adds vertex $8194$ and yields a $578$-concept obstruction with exactly one corner. Degree two is the least possible corner degree in any ample forbidden pc-minor.
